g.text: PP5022 side: who moves bytes, and where to
Each arrow is a master reaching a target; (n) is its cell in docs/data-paths.md §4 (status as of S37)
2 · Out of the PP: to the BCM and the codec (all read SDRAM)
and the IDE controller into IRAM (cells 11, 14);
the COP on peripherals and I2C (9).
the BCM cannot write PP memory (17);
the PP fetches its results by port reads.
